name: Asymmetric Vol
description: Research-only session on ETH and SOL: five new ideas screened (SOL quote staleness, sign-asymmetric vol, SOL's own order flow, stale round-price orders, and the vol decay inside each 15-minute window). None beat fees and spread at real fills, so nothing reached the pipeline.
hypothesis: Main idea (H1): future 15-minute vol depends on the sign of the recent move (leverage effect), and Kalshi prices vol from unsigned trailing vol, so the side the sign favours is cheap. Losers: takers/quoters using unsigned trailing vol. Wrong if signed returns don't predict rest-of-window vol beyond HAR terms in both halves, or the favoured side isn't positive at next fills after fee. Also H0 (SOL staleness), H2 (SOL own flow), H3 (round-price orders), H4 (late-window vol overpriced given the in-window vol decay): see NOTES.md.
next: Rejected at research (H0-H4 all negative at real fills). New ground needs data: KXETHD/KXSOLD hourly ladders (15-min vs hourly at the :00 close), Polymarket 15-min crypto, or more coins' 15-min series.
